flags: Scenic Drives calls the prairie loop 3 miles; the dedicated Elk & Bison Prairie page gives 3.5 miles and controls the practical note.
Homeplace’s 14 original buildings are documented by the manager; Wikipedia calls the farm reconstructed. No claim is made that the buildings remain on their original sites.
Golden Pond page says the last peninsula residents left in 1970; Model page documents Cleo Griffin remaining until 1989. Avoided the old draft’s blanket implication that everyone left together.
Recreation-area page incorrectly credits TVA with constructing both dams in its introduction; its history and the Barkley pages distinguish the Army Corps of Engineers.

No archival or community source is cached for displacement. Limited account to the supported project, named communities and Golden Pond departure dates; omitted the more serious uncorroborated house-burning allegation.
